booster_reward_rule: Every new level gives one booster. A first 3-star clear on levels 3, 6, 9... adds a Shuffle; every 5th new level adds a Cross Blast. Replays cannot farm rewards.
controls_desktop: Mouse/touch: tap or swipe · Keyboard: WASD/arrows, Enter, H, P/Esc
gameplay_tip: Match 4 → Line · T/L → Bomb · Match 5 → Prism · Match 6 → Nova · Tap specials to trigger them or combine neighboring specials.
no_match: That swap does not create a match
special_tap_hint: Tap again to activate, or tap a neighboring special to combine.
title: Gem Cascade
tutorial_objective: Complete every objective before your moves run out. Cascades increase your score multiplier.
tutorial_special: Match 4 for a Line gem, 5 for a Prism, 6 for a Nova, and T/L shapes for a Bomb. Tap specials to trigger them and combine neighboring specials for stronger effects.
tutorial_swap: Swipe or select two adjacent gems. Only swaps that create a match are accepted.
